latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Google AI Video Maker — create polished videos from your images or clips using AI.

- Upload images (JPG, PNG) or clips (MP4, MOV) up to 500MB for AI-powered video creation.
- Simple, guided setup: automatic cloud connection and session management.
- Supports quick edits, batch processing, and iterative enhancements with 1080p MP4 exports.
- One-click actions for uploading, generating, editing, and exporting videos.
- Intuitive prompt-based controls for marketers and content creators; no software install required.
